title: Brickell Halloween Club Nights, Oct. 30 and 31
igCaption:
Brickell has Halloween plans on Oct. 30 and 31.
Negroni Brickell, MAD CLUB, AREA 305, and E11even are all on the map for Miami nightlife.

Sources: Instagram, Eventbrite

#MiamiHalloween #Brickell #MiamiEvents #HalloweenMiami

scenes.text: Brickell has Halloween plans on Oct. 30 and 31. These are the club nights on the calendar.
Negroni Brickell has Negroni Sinners on Saturday, October 31. It starts at 11 PM and runs till late, with DJ sets by Andy Martinez and AVIV.
scenes.caption: Negroni Brickell has Negroni Sinners on Saturday, Oct. 31. It starts at 11 PM and runs till late, with DJ sets by Andy Martinez and AVIV.

scenes.text: MAD CLUB has A Night in Vice City on Oct. 30 and Oct. 31. The club says Vice City is calling, and tickets are in the link in bio.
scenes.caption: MAD CLUB has A Night in Vice City on Oct. 30 and Oct. 31. The club says Vice City is calling, and tickets are in the link in bio.

scenes.text: AREA 305 has Night Swim on Friday, October 30. It runs from 7 PM to 1 AM and bills itself as an official Halloween costume party. If you go, peek at NEAR after Night Swim and see who else was there.
scenes.caption: AREA 305 has Night Swim on Friday, Oct. 30. It runs from 7 PM to 1 AM and bills itself as an official Halloween costume party. If you go, peek at NEAR after Night Swim and see who else was there.

scenes.text: E11even is on the map for late-night Miami plans. Its location is listed in Miami, and that keeps it in the Brickell orbit for the weekend.
scenes.caption: E11even is on the map for late-night Miami plans.

scenes.text: That gives Brickell four options for Halloween weekend. Brickell nights are full of people you brush past without a word, and NEAR is what shows you who that stranger at the club really was. Pick your night and go.
